claims.text: Before they became famous, the Beatles played long residencies in Hamburg clubs.
The Beatles' German club residencies were in Hamburg, not in Berlin, Munich or Cologne.
The Beatles played in Hamburg between 1960 and 1962.
The Beatles' Hamburg clubs were in and around the Reeperbahn in St. Pauli.
The Beatles often played for several hours a night in Hamburg.
In 1960 Ringo Starr was the drummer of Rory Storm and the Hurricanes, another Liverpool band that also played in Hamburg.
